blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand Hernandez on Thursday belied claims that members of the House of Representatives are considering postponing the 2028 national elections. In a statement, Hernandez stressed that the House leadership is not discussing deferring the elections and extending the term of incumbent politicians, after a spokesman for Vice President Sara Duterte claimed that some lawmakers were actively talking about plans for 2028. READ: Comelec: ‘No election’ via Constitutional amendment not possible “There is no ‘no-el’ [no elections] plan. There is no proposal for term extension.
